cache: static BFS; identical frozen membership; no dynamic updates
selection: largest existing candidate threshold satisfying validation Recall>=99.60%; fallback tau0 if infeasible; no test selection
main_model: existing 17-128-64-1 state-only MLP; cached nodes retained
training_label: legacy conservative retain: skip label iff zero admitted neighbours and not final top10; NOT MS MARCO singleton-removal LR label
reuse: disabled in all trace and cost runs
pairs: all 1,000,000 directed history->test pairs; pooled L2 distance quantiles; plus per-target nearest-neighbour ranks and per-target quantile bins
cost_categories: explicit PQ gather and vector copies
cost_limit: exclusive instrumented software regions, not hardware attribution; implicit memory stalls remain within executing region; profile runs separate from timing and trace runs
extensions: test-test pairs, no history construction from test
